title: Policy Development, Technical AI Governance
description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic believes AI capabilities are improving rapidly, and that AI safety policy needs to keep pace. Our Policy Development team translates technical insights into workable new policy ideas for governing frontier AI. As a member of the Policy Development team, you will drive our work on technical and cross-lab safety practices, deepen our work on frontier AI legislation, and develop new technical governance ideas that you pressure-test with researchers and carry into policy proposals. You will work closely with policy colleagues and with research, alignment, safety, and legal teams, and you’ll move easily between technical detail and how policy actually gets made. Key responsibilities Help develop technical safety best practices and standards for frontier development, working closely with policy, research, and safeguards teams Support cross-lab discussions and initiatives and serve as the Anthropic representative in key standards initiatives and groups Review and give substantive input on federal, state, and global frontier AI safety bills, including on risk reporting, independent evaluation, and incident reporting, helping shape AI safety legislation development Work with our external affairs policy teams to strengthen our frontier AI legislative framework Contribute research and analysis across the policy team’s pacing workstreams, including developing novel policy proposals that address challenges related to the acceleration of AI R&D Engage with the external AI safety and governance community to track new thinking and feed it into our own Write clear memos and briefings that help leadership align on decisions Minimum qualifications Are fluent in frontier AI safety and technical AI governance: the main players, proposals, and debates Can read legislative text and comment usefully on it Have expertise in any of the following domains: loss-of-control, alignment, compute governance, independent evaluation, model weight security, risk reporting Write clearly for researchers, leadership, and policymakers Can pick up new technical topics quickly and translate them to the broader policy landscape Are comfortable with ambiguity and can own a project end to end Preferred qualifications Are excited about standards work, and also want to contribute across the wider technical governance agenda Have direct experience in an AI governance or safety research organization or frontier lab Have experience working closely with standards bodies or industry consortia Have experience developing and shaping technical legislation Have published novel policy thinking on AI governance The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $265,000 — $295,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. title: Senior Manager, Corporate Accounting & Finance Transformation
description: Strength in Trust  OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.   The Challenge We are seeking a highly motivated and Senior Manager of Corporate Accounting to help drive the next phase of our accounting organization’s evolution. This role sits at the intersection of accounting, controls, and business transformation. The ideal candidate combines deep accounting expertise with operational leadership capabilities and a passion for process improvement. This individual will help establish a scalable controls environment, lead reporting initiatives, and assist in developing the company's AI governance and controls framework. Your Mission Internal Controls & Risk Management Design, implement, and continuously improve a scalable internal controls framework across accounting and finance processes. Partner with process owners to identify control gaps, evaluate risks, and implement sustainable remediation plans. Support SOX readiness, compliance programs, and internal audit activities. Develop control documentation, narratives, risk assessments, and testing methodologies. Establish governance processes around emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions. Monitor evolving accounting standards and assess organizational impact. Systems Implementation & Process Improvement Support finance transformation initiatives, including ERP, reporting, consolidation, and workflow automation projects. Serve as a key accounting stakeholder during system implementations and enhancements. Evaluate existing processes and recommend automation opportunities. Develop scalable accounting workflows that improve efficiency while maintaining control integrity. Assist in roadmap planning for finance technology investments. Data Integrity & Governance Partner with Finance Systems, Business Systems, and Data teams to improve master data quality and governance. Support initiatives focused on financial data accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Develop monitoring processes and controls around critical financial datasets. Assist in root-cause analysis and remediation of data quality issues impacting financial reporting. AI Governance & Controls Framework Assist in establishing an AI Controls Center of Excellence within the finance organization. Develop policies, standards, and governance frameworks for AI-enabled accounting and finance processes. Design controls around AI-generated outputs, model monitoring, data integrity, and regulatory compliance. Partner with Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, and Business Systems to develop an enterprise AI control environment. Evaluate opportunities to responsibly leverage AI to improve accounting operations and decision-making. You Are/Have Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance. CPA required. 8+ years of progressive accounting, audit, financial reporting, or finance transformation experience. Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, technical accounting, and financial reporting requirements. Experience designing and implementing internal controls. Proven project management and cross-functional leadership skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities. Extra Awesome Big 4 public accounting experience. Experience supporting M&A integrations and carve-outs. Experience with system implementations and finance transformation initiatives. Knowledge of SOX 404, COSO, and internal audit methodologies. Experience with Workday, NetSuite, SAP, or other enterprise financial systems. Exposure to AI governance, automation tools, or data governance programs. title: Senior Product Counsel
description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations:  Austin, TX Washington D.C. San Francisco, CA About this job Cloudflare is seeking a lawyer with a passion for new technologies to join the Product Counsel team. The Product Counsel team serves as the frontline legal contact and helps solve some of the company’s thorniest issues. As a member of the team, you’ll wear many hats and lead cross-functional projects with meaningful impact. The ideal candidate brings deep enthusiasm for innovative technology and the ability to collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business teams throughout the software development and commercialization lifecycle. This role requires drafting and negotiating the technology transactions that fuel our products, such as our AI inference offerings. Through this work, you will help evaluate novel legal questions and craft practical solutions at the frontier of law and technology. As a member of the Product Counsel team, you will also support privacy-by-design reviews, document data flows for responsible AI counseling, and partner with the commercial legal team to address complex customer inquiries. In this role, you will: Translate complex legal analysis into clear, actionable guidance for fast-moving product and engineering teams. Proactively assess legal risks and advise product, engineering and business teams building services that reshape how information moves across the Internet—and the laws that govern it. Serve as a legal advisor to senior business leaders on the legal implications of product strategy. Review and architect legal frameworks for technology transactions related agreements, such as, technology partner agreements, inbound IP licensing agreements, and marketplace arrangements for Cloudflare’s developer platform. Review marketing event agreements and support Cloudflare’s team with promotions and sweepstakes. Draft terms of service, disclosures, policies, and related processes. Apply privacy-by-design principles and partner with the privacy team on data-flow reviews, PIAs, and other privacy deliverables. Solicit invention disclosures, support patent strategy, and protect Cloudflare’s trade secrets. Partner with product and marketing teams on product marketing collateral and claim substantiation. Build and refine processes that enable the Legal team to scale effectively as Cloudflare continues to expand. Engage externally on behalf of Cloudflare in areas where you are a subject matter expert. Job qualifications JD degree with strong academic credentials and admitted to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction. 7+ years of law firm and/or in-house experience, preferably with technology companies. Prior experience with Internet security and infrastructure companies is desired. Technical background / expertise is highly desired. While a science or technical degree is not a prerequisite for this job, a passion for technologies is. Ability to provide legal advice in a way that understands and advances strategic business goals. Experience with copyright law and Internet law is desired (e.g., AI Act, Data Act, net neutrality, DMCA, CFAA). Strong communication skills and cooperative team player. Lead with empathy and understanding while embracing diverse points of view. Flexibility to adapt and thrive in a fast paced environment. Ability to work cross-functionally, with lawyers and non-lawyers, including senior business executives, to establish effective solutions efficient
